# SENTINEL Synthetic Test Corpus

This archive contains 200 fictional TXT documents (50 in each folder) for testing document loading, cleaning, chunking, embedding, Qdrant upsert, and semantic search.

## Folder structure

- `rbi_npci/` — synthetic payment-security and dispute-control guidance examples
- `playbooks/` — synthetic analyst workflow examples
- `investigator_notes/` — fictional investigation note examples
- `chargeback_narratives/` — fictional dispute narrative examples

## Important

These are **synthetic training fixtures**, not official RBI/NPCI circulars, legal guidance, actual investigator notes, or real chargeback records. They contain no real customer identifiers or payment credentials. Do not present them as regulatory source documents or use them to validate production fraud decisions.

## Count

200 TXT files total: 50 per folder.

Document ID: SYN-CHARGEBACK_NARRATIVES-001
Document Type: chargeback_narratives
Title: Goods not received — Scenario 001
Classification: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA
Status: Training example only

Summary
The fictional cardholder disputes a purchase because the goods were reportedly not received. Evidence may include fulfilment status, delivery confirmation, and customer communications.

Operational details
This is a fictional example created to test the SENTINEL document ingestion, text cleaning, chunking, embedding, and Qdrant search workflow. Scenario reference 001 is not associated with a real person, customer, merchant, payment, or investigation.

Review guidance
The control owner should maintain an auditable record of the review.
Record the source, relevant timestamps, evidence reviewed, decision rationale, and any follow-up action. Where a policy threshold is required, use the approved project configuration rather than inventing a value.
